population.source: WorldPop Global 2000-2020 population grid, 1 km aggregated
population.method: area-weighted sum of 1 km source cells into the 0.1 degree grid, computed in degrees
population.note: Modelled population, not a census. Not the population on the day of a fire.

infrastructure.hospitals_source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API: amenity=hospital (counted); clinic and doctors, healthcare=clinic (counted apart)
infrastructure.schools_source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API: amenity=school|kindergarten (counted per cell)
infrastructure.roads_source: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API: highway=motorway|trunk|primary, ways with a name or ref, merged by name and class
infrastructure.scope: Only facilities and roads inside a 0.1 degree cell that has had fire since 2000 are kept, so a distance to fire is 0 by construction.
